title: Offers a job that pays a lot for little work
why: Offers of big daily pay for part-time or home work, with no skills needed, are how task and deposit scams start. Check the company before replying.
examples: Work from home, earn 3000 per day, no experience needed.
Part time job vacancy, earn Rs 5000 daily with your phone.
safe: We are hiring a full-time accountant. Apply on our careers page.
Your interview for the software engineer role is on Monday at 10 am.
